ig_carousel_topic.topic: Why your win rate matters less than your ROI
ig_carousel_topic.slide1_text: Your win rate is lying to you.
ig_carousel_topic.slide2_text: Most bettors chase 60%, 65%, higher. They think a bigger win rate means more money. It usually doesn't.
ig_carousel_topic.slide3_text: ROI is what actually hits your bankroll. A 54% bettor risking 1 unit to win 2 beats a 60% bettor laying -200 every game. The math is that simple.
ig_carousel_topic.slide4_text: Example: Bettor A goes 54-46 at -110 odds. Net: +4.2u. Bettor B goes 60-40 but averages -180 odds. Net: -1.8u. Same 100 bets. Bettor A wins.
ig_carousel_topic.slide5_text: SmarterPicks sits at 54.1% this season, +45.4u, 9.3% ROI across 499 graded picks. Win rate is fine. ROI is the number that matters.
